notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Wildwood Mentor's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Wildwood Mentor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Servos.
